profile.workload: generated slot-1 sample with held Trig 1 and all fifteen prior TCG helpers enabled

modeled_operations: eight ordered input loads and post-increment updates
four fractional saturated accumulators per iteration
QEMU-identical fractional accumulator extraction and clear
loop-counter and final ColdFire condition-code state

verifier_correction.finding: The first candidate run exposed that the shared model truncated the accumulator directly instead of applying QEMU's fractional extraction, rounding, and OMC saturation semantics.
verifier_correction.result: Mirroring QEMU get_macf semantics makes both cursor horizons identical and strengthens every verifier candidate using the shared primitive.

conclusion: The exact per-PC profile isolated the residual leaf's only repeated segment, and its transactional clean-room reconstruction matches all 35 registers and all 60 touched bytes at early and late horizons without fallback.
next_gate: Promote emac2x4 to a sixteenth guarded direct-state helper, then measure its exact 100-service reduction and held-audio behavior.

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: Only clean-room topology and aggregate results are committed. No Elektron firmware, project data, sample names, PCM, runtime values, runtime trace, or instruction bytes are committed.
